text:
ellie: Quick sync: ops asked for a 'quiet degrade' UX variant for automatic fallback. They want the routing to ramp in over a minute (not a hard flip) and for the console to show it as "shadow -> partial" rather than a full switch. Thoughts on how we present this + audit/export needs?

tom: ramping is good to avoid oscillation. UI: show a tiny progress bar inside the pill: `shadow 30% -> cheaper-quant` with ttl and a small delta-cost badge. Avoid banners.

yara: from telemetry side we need the exact evaluation chain: which signal drove the decision (e.g., infra_503_window, p95_ms) + the intermediate percentages during ramp. Emit `rollout.evaluation` events every 10s while ramping so playback can reconstruct.

oscar: audit/export: ops wants a single signed CSV export that contains the timeline + hashes of sampled inputs + who (bot vs user) initiated any manual overrides. CSV should be reproducible by the playback tool. We should include a header row with rollout config JSON as a compact string.

audit-bot: audit-bot: rollout 6001234567 started by @ellie 6001234567 -> contingency enter at 6001234570 (trigger=p95_latency_ms>1100). ramping: 10% @6001234572, 30% @6001234578. logs -> https://internal.logs/r/6001234567

beth: security note: sampled inputs must be opt-in per-tenant. If enabled, store only salted sha256 and first 64 chars of the hash. Also add a 'redact sensitive tokens' preprocessor before any snapshot is saved.

ey: sorry, small correction: we should call the mode "gradual-fallback" in the API to avoid confusion with existing "soft-switchover".

tom: API sketch: POST /api/v1/rollouts with body including `{ "mode": "gradual-fallback", "ramp_duration_s": 60, "ramp_steps": [10,30,60], "triggers": [ ... ], "sampling": {"rate": 0.01, "capture_inputs": false} }`. server will emit `ramp_progress` events.

yara: when simulated/dry_run we still need to emit the same `ramp_progress` events but mark them `simulated=true`. playback should be able to run the same timeline and optionally inject recorded model outputs if captured.

oscar: export CSV columns proposal: `ts,actor,action,mode,step_pct,trigger,trigger_value,samples_count,hash_list,simulated,notes,config_blob`. `hash_list` can be empty if sampling off. Signed export = we put an export token in header and mark in audit.

audit-bot: audit-bot: note -> exports require role `audit_exporter`. Export requests will create an `export_job` in the system and emit `audit.export.created` events.

beth: compliance: add a tenant-level flag `allow_sample_capture`. UI should grey-out capture toggle when disabled and show a tooltip: "Disabled by org policy". Also make sampling default off for all enterprise and gov tenants.

ey: UX: pill state sequence: idle -> pending (spinner) -> ramp (progress bar) -> fallback-active (ttl timer) -> normal. Keep pill small. clicking opens timeline modal with CSV/export CTA and a 'promote' or 'manual revert' button (RBAC-gated).

tom: for manual revert, require an audit comment. We should also support a "cooldown" param so the policy won't auto-trigger again for X seconds after a manual action. Add cooldown to schema.

yara: telemetry extras: capture p50/p90/p95 snapshots at moment of ramp start and end. Store metrics with rollout_id tag. Also add a `rollout.impact_estimate` event that estimates token and $ delta for the ramp window.

oscar: playback: it should accept either the signed CSV or an operation id and fetch the timeline + (optional) sample snapshots. It replays events to the dev sandbox so you can reproduce. Keep exports small by truncating hash lists to first N = 20 unless user picks full export (RBAC).

audit-bot: audit-bot: caution -> when sampling enabled, system will mark exported CSVs with `PII=true` and require `audit_exporter_with_pii` role to download.

beth: add encryption-at-rest for sampled artifacts and rotate keys quarterly. Also log access to sample blobs in a separate audit stream with 365-day retention for enterprise.

ellie: owners: @tom UI + API schema, @yara telemetry + playback hooks, @beth compliance/security, @oscar audit/export shape. i'll draft a FigJam microflow and a tiny API PR. thanks all. :sparkles:
